title: Great Expectations Validation Failures
dataSources: Monte Carlo incident webhooks (`montecarlo:incident`), Great Expectations `validation_result` JSON (`great_expectations:validation`), Soda scan results (`soda:scan`), dbt test failures, warehouse `INFORMATION_SCHEMA` freshness/volume probes via DB Connect.
app: Monte Carlo / Bigeye / Soda webhooks and REST APIs via HEC; Great Expectations and dbt test results via HEC scripted inputs; custom warehouse data-quality probes via Splunk DB Connect.
spl:
index=dataops sourcetype=great_expectations:validation
| stats sum(evaluated_expectations) as checks, sum(unsuccessful_expectations) as failures by expectation_suite_name, data_asset_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Parses Great Expectations validation results and surfaces suites with failing expectations, giving code-defined data-quality checks operational visibility.
value: Great Expectations catches bad data at the pipeline boundary; surfacing failures ensures the checks actually stop bad data instead of failing unseen.
implementation: Emit validation-result JSON to HEC after each run; schedule after validations; alert on failures for critical assets.
visualization: Table of failing suites by asset, timechart of validation failures.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the data-quality rules your engineers wrote and flag when the data breaks them, so bad data is stopped early.
